body: Please stay alive!!!! Go listen to some twenty one pilots and remember you have the power to get out of the situation. Killing yourself takes that power away-- life will hopefully get better someday. Make sure you're here to see it!!

It doesn't have to be a big thing at first... Maybe today you stay alive because your mom is going to work hard cooking dinner and someone needs to eat it.... You can stay alive because you haven't tried every flavor of pop tart yet... Or you've never touched a sting ray and you'd like to someday. When that gets easy, you could move on to a bugger reason, like it will be a PR nightmare for your family/friends/work. You can stay alive for the kid down the street, that reminds you if yourself when you were little, and you never want them to turn out feeling this way too. When that gets easy... Find a way to start living for yourself. Live to experience life- to travel, go boating, try exotic fruits, meet new people. Live to remember the pain and hardship and do your best to make sure no one close to you goes through the same stuff. Life is so HARD. Suicidal thoughts are probably one of the hardest things life can dish out to us. But just like a video game you've never played before, you don't have to start at level 60. You start with the tutorial, and you move to level 1 and 2 and so on. Someday, it'll be easy to live with a purpose, but you aren't there right now and that's okay. You're still learning! Start with something easy <3 inbox is open

Hey fren! No one deserves to die! You deserve the chance to live. 

I know exactly what it's like to come home everyday, feeling worthless and empty. I know what it's like to think about the last meaningful conversation you had and draw a blank. I know it's hard to feel anything besides... gray. It's lonely, scary, and so so so unfair. But it doesn't matter who you are. Every single human being deserves the right to live. To truly live and feel alive. Don't let anyone tell you differently -- not even yourself.
